audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: none of Teemo's abilities are named, and the one mechanic that decides the lane is stated wrongly — "Blind (Q) ... cancels your empowered autos entirely" is treated as if it shuts your whole pattern off.
audit.why: Blinding Dart blinds basic attacks only. Tongue Lash still lands and still applies An Acquired Taste through a blind. That single fact changes the lane from 'wait out the blind' to 'Q him while he thinks he is safe'. Its cooldown is also a flat 7 seconds at every rank, while Tongue Lash drops to 5 — at Q max you get a stack more often than he gets a dart.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart (7s flat, 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3s blind) stops basic attacks only; Tongue Lash keeps stacking through it. Also name Toxic Shot (E), Move Quick (W), Noxious Trap (R) and Guerrilla Warfare (P).

audit.whatIsWrong: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json tags Noxious Trap with a "knockup" flag, and _missing-interactions.json therefore claims "Both sides carry displacement (Abyssal Dive (W) vs Noxious Trap (R)) — whoever lands it first owns the trade."
audit.why: Mushrooms do not displace anything. They arm after 1 second, last up to 5 minutes, and on contact apply a 30/40/50% slow for 4 seconds plus poison. Treating a shroom as a displacement race is a fabricated interaction that would have gone straight into the text if I had trusted the derived flag.
audit.corrected: Noxious Trap: 1s arm, 5 minute lifetime, 30/40/50% slow for 4s, 35/30/25s per charge with 3/4/5 charges. No displacement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls Tahm Kench's W "Abyssal Voyage" and treats it as a repositioning tool Teemo "cannot shroom in advance" and whose "landing spots" he can deny.
audit.why: His W is Abyssal Dive: a 1.35-second channel into a short blink, range 1000-1200, on 21/20/19/18/17s. Against a champion with Move Quick, 1.35 seconds of telegraph is enough for Teemo to simply walk off the marked spot. The full layer's "W-dive to close on his kite" is the same mistake — diving a free-running Teemo is how you lose the cooldown for nothing.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive lands on a Teemo who is already slowed by Tongue Lash or held by the 1.5s stun. It is not a chase tool against Move Quick.
sources: League Wiki — Tahm Kench: Abyssal Dive

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] ("Lvl 3") and the early paragraph both describe landing "the stun into Devour" at level 3, and early claims that burning Blinding Dart gives you "a clear 1.5-second window".
audit.why: Devour is the ultimate and arrives at 6, not 3. And a spent Blinding Dart gives you its full flat 7-second cooldown, not 1.5 seconds — the 1.5s figure is the Tongue Lash stun duration, apparently pasted into the wrong slot. Both errors shrink a real window into a fake one.
audit.corrected: Level 3 gives the 1.5s stun and autos. A burned dart is seven seconds of freedom. Devour joins at 6.
sources: League Wiki — Tahm Kench: Tongue Lash

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states how long An Acquired Taste stacks survive, in the one matchup where it decides everything.
audit.why: Stacks last 5 seconds and then fall off one at a time every 0.67s. A 2-3 second blind lands squarely inside that window, so eating a dart at two stacks does not just delay your combo — it can time your stacks out entirely. Stack and commit in one motion, or expect to start again.
audit.corrected: An Acquired Taste holds for 5 seconds from the last application, then decays one stack per 0.67s.
sources: League Wiki — Tahm Kench: An Acquired Taste

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree completely and the full layer disagrees with the result. Tahm Kench wins 54.57% over 898 games, yet the full layer rates the lane HARD at 8.5/10 and hands Teemo 5 of 7 stages, while the content chart hands Tahm Kench 6 of 7.
audit.why: Tongue Lash reaches 900 against Blinding Dart's 680 and Toxic Shot's 680, it heals on champion hit, Thick Skin banks the poison as grey health, and Teemo has no dash to escape a 1.5s stun. That is a lane Tahm Kench should be favoured in, and the win rate agrees. The content chart is close to right; the full layer's HARD / 8.5 rating is not.
audit.corrected: Difficulty around 6/10 with the early levels belonging to Tahm Kench, not Teemo.

edits.before: Teemo's Blind (Q) is the one ability you must respect — it cancels your empowered autos entirely, so never commit to a trade while it is up. Open with Tongue Lash from max range to apply the first stack and slow him before he can juke sideways, then walk up for the second auto. If he burns Blind pre-emptively you have a clear 1.5-second window to land the third stack and stun him; the moment the stun lands you Devour, holding him through the full duration while Thick Skin passively banks the poison damage as grey health you heal back between waves. He has zero escape from a clean 3-stack combo at level 3 — your job levels 1-3 is to bait that Blind as often as possible.
edits.after: Blinding Dart is the one ability you must respect — but it stops basic attacks only, for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3s, so it kills your auto stacking and never touches Tongue Lash. Open with Q from max range to apply the first stack and slow him before he can juke sideways, then walk up for the second auto. If he burns the dart pre-emptively you own the next 7 seconds — that is its flat cooldown at every rank — so land the third stack and take the 1.5s stun. Thick Skin banks his Toxic Shot poison as grey health you heal back between waves. He has no escape from a clean 3-stack setup at level 3; your job levels 1-3 is to bait that dart as often as possible.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where Teemo gets his freedom back. Without Abyssal Voyage you have no gap-closer, and his move-speed passive lets him kite out of Tongue Lash range if he respects the slow. Do not force a 3-stack combo over open ground — fish for it in the narrow lane corridor near the minion wave and let him overextend for CS instead. Activate Thick Skin the moment his Blind expires each trade so his poison converts to a shield rather than damage; he cannot out-sustain that exchange if you time the E correctly. At 6 the dynamic shifts again: Abyssal Voyage gives you a repositioning threat he cannot shroom in advance, and the stun-into-Devour combo is now backed by enough base tankiness that his poison damage cannot end the fight before you complete the punish.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where Teemo gets his freedom back. Abyssal Dive is a 1.35-second channel rather than a gap-closer, and Move Quick lets him kite out of Tongue Lash range if he respects the slow. Do not force a 3-stack combo over open ground — fish for it in the narrow lane corridor near the minion wave and let him overextend for CS instead. Activate Thick Skin as his Toxic Shot poison ticks so the chip converts to a shield rather than damage; he cannot out-sustain that exchange if you time the E correctly. At 6 the dynamic shifts again: Devour arrives, and the stun-into-Devour combo is now backed by enough base tankiness that his poison cannot end the fight before you complete the punish.
